question.text:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I: can be synthesized from using simpler reagents in the order i) Acidic $\mathrm{KMnO}_{4}$, ii) Ammonia, iii) Bromine and alkali
Statement II: can be converted into using reagents in the order i) Bromine- $\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}$ ii) $\mathrm{NaNO}_{2} / \mathrm{HCl}\left(0-5^{\circ} \mathrm{C}\right)$ (iii) Aq. $\mathrm{H}_{3} \mathrm{PO}_{2}$.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below

options.text: Statement I is false but Statement II is true
Both Statement I and Statement II are true
Statement I is true but Statement II is false
Both Statement I and Statement II are false
